tools.name: get_fill_form
tools.description: Read the form behind a fill code: questions, types, limits and what to do next. Does not use up the code. Ask the person for missing answers, show them everything, and submit only after they say yes.

tools.name: submit_fill
tools.description: Submit answers with a fill code. One successful use per code, at most 5 attempts. 201-equivalent result has response_id and receipt: tell the person the receipt. On invalid_answers fix the listed fields and call again.
